rules.name: process_substitution
rules.behaviorNote: Process substitution `<(...)` / `>(...)` is a syntax error in BusyBox ash.
rules.fixHint: Use a temporary file or pipe into a subshell (`cmd1 | while IFS= read -r ...`).

rules.name: here_string
rules.behaviorNote: Here-string `<<<` is a syntax error in BusyBox ash.
rules.fixHint: Use `printf '%s\n' "..." | cmd` or a standard heredoc `<<'EOF'`.

rules.name: double_bracket_test
rules.behaviorNote: Extended conditional `[[ ... ]]` is not supported in BusyBox ash.
rules.fixHint: Use POSIX `[ ... ]` (`test`) or `case` for pattern matching.

rules.name: declare_or_typeset
rules.behaviorNote: `declare` / `typeset` arrays and attributes do not exist in BusyBox ash.
rules.fixHint: Use standard POSIX variables or `awk`/`python3` for associative/indexed arrays.

rules.name: shopt_builtin
rules.fixHint: Use POSIX `set` options or `find` instead of `shopt -s nullglob/globstar`.

rules.name: read_array
rules.behaviorNote: `read -a` array assignment is not supported in BusyBox ash.
rules.fixHint: Use `set -- $line` positional parameters or `read -r a b c`.

rules.name: array_literal
rules.behaviorNote: Indexed array literals `arr=(...)` are a syntax error in BusyBox ash.
rules.fixHint: Use positional parameters `set -- item1 item2` or newline-delimited strings.

rules.name: combined_redirect
rules.behaviorNote: Combined stdout/stderr redirect `&>` or `|&` is misparsed in POSIX sh.

rules.name: array_or_indirect_expansion
rules.behaviorNote: Array expansion `${arr[@]}` and indirect expansion `${!var}` fail in BusyBox ash.

rules.name: brace_sequence_expansion
rules.behaviorNote: Brace sequence `{start..end}` is not expanded by BusyBox ash by default.

rules.name: bash_special_vars
rules.behaviorNote: Bash-only special variables expand to empty in BusyBox ash.
rules.fixHint: Capture exit codes explicitly or run under `/bin/bash`.
